title: Canonical Audio Source, Asset, Cue & Soundscape Schema

future_start_resolution: freshly verify then-current AIOC and application heads and re-read the completed AAI-01 provider/API/license/authority evidence before schema decisions

define provider-neutral identities and relationships for AudioProvider, AudioSource, AudioAsset, MusicTrack, Ambience, OneShot, Soundscape, AudioCue, MixPreset, Playlist and ProviderReference without making any provider or catalog canonical
keep semantic audio intent, provider identity and provider asset/reference identity separate and define explicit unresolved/silent/manual states
define provenance, entitlement, license, attribution, recording/streaming/caching/export and source-evidence fields without inferring rights from file possession or provider availability
define capability and compatibility references that preserve AAI-01 supported/unsupported/unknown/fail-closed evidence rather than inventing provider operations
define stable IDs, deterministic serialization/versioning and schema validation boundaries while preserving existing World/Event/Scene/Combat/gameplay owners
determine whether AAI-02 actually requires durable runtime persistence and only then decide whether migration 0022 is needed; selection itself does not reserve it
resolve exact AAI-02 deliverables, tests/verifier, compatibility contract and acceptance gate before creating an implementation branch
selection_contract.authority_rule: Selection authorizes planning resolution only. It does not authorize an implementation branch, runtime schema code, database migration, provider adapters, authentication, catalog access, acquisition/download/copying, scraping, payment, tester distribution, release or deployment.
selection_contract.provider_rule: AAI-02 must model provider-neutral references and evidence without turning commercial provider content into Multiversal-owned data or assuming unsupported provider capabilities.
selection_contract.owner_rule: Audio schema may describe presentation/support intent and state but cannot create or replace canonical World, Event, Scene, Combat, Action or other gameplay truth.

preserved_boundaries: AAI-01 is completed_verified with no further implementation authority
AAI-02 is selected_not_started with no implementation branch or implementation authority
audio intent remains separate from provider identity and provider asset/reference identity
no provider/catalog is canonical and unsupported/unknown capability remains explicit and fail closed
commercial provider audio remains controlled/referenced rather than copied absent explicit license
user-owned file possession does not infer redistribution/public-performance/commercial rights
Pocket Bard scraping/reverse engineering restrictions and Tabletop Audio SoundPad site-bound restrictions remain binding evidence
missing or disabled audio never blocks play
migration 0022 remains unreserved until a separately demonstrated durable schema delta requires it
no provider acquisition/download/authentication/scraping/payment, tester distribution, release/deployment or real-money activation is authorized by selection
next_action: Selection only. On the next owner Continue, freshly verify then-current AIOC/application heads, re-read AAI-01 completed evidence plus the AAI program/backlog and this selection contract, resolve the exact provider-neutral AAI-02 schema/persistence/validation contract, and only then governed-start AAI-02. Until then do not create an implementation branch or reserve migration 0022.
